subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Tue Aug 18 shortlist | thin day — 2 candidates (HTHT breakout leads)
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, August 18, 2026 — Kuwait time

Thin day — 2 candidates cleared all 4 gates

25 searches across all lanes surfaced ~20 raw tickers. Most were stale, already-faded, or hard-excluded. Only HTHT and ETON survived Gate 1–4 with live IBKR confirmation. No padding today — see the cut list below for exactly what got dropped and why.

Cap-size mix

1 large cap (HTHT), 1 small cap (ETON). Scan genuinely produced only 2 clean setups today — the large-cap lane (25 stocks, incl. AAPL, ABNB, ZM upgrades) mostly failed live-price confirmation; small/mid-cap lane was dominated by defense-adjacent contract names that got hard-excluded.

Momentum Shortlist

#1 — HTHT H World Group Ltd (ADR) ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

HOTELS / CONSUMER LARGE CAP

Signal: Q2 earnings beat (adj. EPS $0.78 vs $0.72 est) + raised FY26 revenue guidance (4–8%, up from 2–6%) + new $2.5B three-year buyback/dividend plan, all announced Aug 17. Stock gapped from $41.88 to $46.61 close (+11.3%) on 3.1M shares — 3-4x normal volume. Holding the gap today, 1 trading day ago.

Price: $46.21 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: $89M (IBKR) | RS vs SPY: +11% single-day vs flat market — clear outperformance.

Why it's interesting: Classic post-earnings-drift shape this strategy targets — the event risk is already behind it, guidance went up not down, and management just committed $2.5B to buying the stock back. Volume confirms institutions bought the gap, not just retail.

Realistic near-term target: +8-16% over 5-10 trading days — round-number resistance at $50, stretch toward $53.50 if the buyback keeps supporting the tape.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — not extended, only 1 day off the gap, still well below its $56.63 52-week high.

Order plan (GTC, all legs together):
BUY limit $46.30
Stop-limit trigger $44.60 / limit $44.30 (just below Monday's breakout-day low $44.76 and the pre-gap $43 resistance shelf)
TP1 sell limit $50.00 · TP2 sell limit $53.50
Size: ~1.73 shares ≈ $80 (~15% of $534 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.2:1
Event window: Earnings behind it ✅ — time-stop ~Aug 28 if flat
Halal: ✅ Verified — hotel operator/franchisor (Hanting, JI Hotel, Steigenberger, Deutsche Hospitality brands); core business is lodging, incidental F&B/alcohol at properties treated the same as any hotel name.
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear
Sizing note: ADR, fractional-eligible on IBKR.
Next step: analyze HTHT
#2 — ETON Eton Pharmaceuticals ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

SPECIALTY PHARMA SMALL CAP

Signal: Q2 blowout Friday Aug 14 — revenue nearly doubled YoY to $37.6M (vs $26.9M est), adj. EPS $0.43 vs $0.15 est, FY26 guidance raised to $145M+ from $120M+. Stock gapped from $40.80 to $58.86 close (+44%) on 1.58M shares, then continued +4.9% Monday to $61.73 on still-elevated volume (832K). Flat today, holding near the highs.

Price: $61.71 (IBKR live) | Avg daily $ vol: $31M (IBKR) | RS vs SPY: +51% over 2 sessions vs a flat tape.

Why it's interesting: Earnings-driven, not a binary FDA bet — fits the post-Jul-27 mandate directly. Real revenue/margin inflection (Hemangeol relaunch), all-time high, multiple analysts (B. Riley, Canaccord, HC Wainwright) raised targets after the print, not before it.

Realistic near-term target: +12% from a pullback entry — no historical resistance overhead (all-time high), so this target is a conservative round-trip estimate, not a measured move off a prior level.

Entry read: ⚠️ WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $57-59 (Friday's high/support shelf) — chasing at $61.71 means buying after a +51% two-day move with no give-back yet. Correct thesis, bad entry price right now.

Order plan (GTC, only fills on pullback):
BUY limit $58.00
Stop-limit trigger $55.50 / limit $55.00 (below Monday's low $56.65)
TP1 sell limit $65.00
Size: ~1.38 shares ≈ $80 (~15% of $534 net liq) · R:R ≈ 2.3:1 if filled
Event window: Earnings behind it ✅ — no pending FDA/PDUFA event
Halal: ✅ Verified — rare-disease specialty pharma (Hemangeol, Increlex biosimilar, Galzin); permissible core business.
Defense/military check: ✅ Clear
Sizing note: $80 on a ~$58 pullback entry clears the ~2.5% commission drag comfortably given the 12% target.
Next step: analyze ETON

Cut this run: GSIT — defense-contract catalyst risk (Army SBIR edge-AI platform is this name's documented "defense applications" business) · ALM (Almonty Industries) — its entire Sangdong tungsten ramp, the actual catalyst, runs on a 15-year offtake agreement "solely for U.S. Defense Applications" with a defense contractor · PLTR — growth thesis is expanding government/defense/intelligence contracts · ALAB — search said it "surged" Monday on a Northland upgrade, but IBKR shows the pop spiked intraday to $354 then fully reversed to close flat at $320.17, now $313 today — FADED vs live data · CODI — spiked to $13.05 near its 52w high Monday then reversed to close −4.8% at $12.10; also carries a weapons/ammunition-adjacent subsidiary (Velocity Outdoor, airguns/ammo) inside its 10-company diversified holding structure · AAPL — Rothschild's $400 target is a 2027+ foldable-iPhone thesis, not a live catalyst; IBKR shows the stock flat/rangebound $302-314 for two weeks on normal volume · ABNB — B.Riley's raised target ($170) sits below the current live price ($179) — stale, no room left · ZM — Citi's raised target ($106) is barely above the current live price ($105.46) — negligible edge · regional banks (SouthState, Regions, Customers Bancorp, Five Star Bancorp) — conventional banking, haram on sight · MANH — real gap-up but from Jul 28-29, well outside the 5-trading-day freshness window.

🏆 Today's best setup

HTHT — the event risk (earnings) is already resolved, guidance went up, and a $2.5B buyback is actively supporting the stock while the shortlist is still 1 day fresh with no give-back. ETON is the more explosive story but requires patience for a pullback; HTHT is the one that's actionable today without chasing.

Invalidation: a close back below $43.00 (the pre-gap resistance shelf) — that would mean the entire earnings gap got given back and the thesis (post-earnings drift, buyback support) is wrong.

How to use this

Pick a name, run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive (fundamentals, event risk map, stop-limit level), then log any entry with portfolio-manager. This shortlist alone is not enough to enter — it's a first filter. Note: live IBKR check shows cash available $431.56, net liq $533.97 (0.3 GOOG shares held, ~$102 mkt value) — sizing above uses $534 net liq at 15%; confirm current cash before placing orders since $431.56 already covers both order plans with room to spare.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa. Generated Aug 18, 2026 Kuwait time.
